{{Top|leg}}
'''Mong'tar Cantina and Brasserie''' was a seedy and noisy [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mong'tar City|Mong'tar]] on [[Bogg 5|Bogg V]]. It was here where [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] rendezvoused with [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]] and introduced to [[TK-0]] and [[Gaib]].
